correction.source: GeckoTerminal hourly USD candles summed over the America/New_York day (candle open from 12:00:00 AM to the next midnight, exclusive). Every discovered pool at or above $100 current h24, each pool once, including PancakeSwap Infinity, Uniswap v4, and Solana pools DexScreener token-pairs does not list. Pools under that floor were not fetched. A pool whose candle window does not cover the day keeps the stored value and is tagged.
